The '''Bactriasa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the regions known as the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Bactriasan scarab]]s.<ref name="Galladinium" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bactriasa system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-10.<ref name="TEA" />
